description:
Prepares, untimed, the per-frame quality record of the AFF3CT sum-product INTRA arm over the recorded bundles.

## Background

The gf2 arms of the LDPC batch decoder and the AFF3CT arms [Cassagne2019] are built or catalogued under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` and `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms.json`. The workloads are the recorded DVB-T2 normal rate-1/2 and 5G NR base-graph-1 lifting-384 mother-code bundles of `dev/active/c077a88b`, pinned by digest, with random and all-zero codewords and a prepared per-frame quality record. The INTRA arm has no prepared quality record in that corpus, and an arm checks its per-frame bit errors against a prepared record on each execution.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A quality record of the INTRA arm over both recorded bundles is committed under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/quality-intra/` with the ordered per-frame error vector, frame and bit error counts, their intervals and the iteration distribution.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record is a single deterministic replay of each full bundle, untimed, and states the arm's observed decoder class and settings.
- [hard] REQ-03: The INTRA arm reproduces the record in a second replay.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Prepare the quality record of the sum-product INTRA arm
